programme.title: Snooker: Northern Ireland Open
programme.desc: Northern Ireland Open in Belfast. Im vergangenen Jahr gab es im Viertelfinale ein Duell zweier Nordiren. Am Ende setzte sich Mark Allen gegen Jordan Brown durch und zog in die Runde der letzten vier ein, wo er gegen Judd Trump unterlag. \n\nDamit blieb ihm der dritte Titel in Belfast nach 2021 und 2022 verwehrt. Diesmal hat das Los Mark Allen, der im August und September aus „persönlichen Gründen“

programme.title: Snooker: Northern Ireland Open
programme.desc: Bei den China Open schied Matthew Selt (41) in der ersten Runde aus, bei den English Open erreichte er immerhin Runde zwei. Für die Wuhan, British und Shenzhen Open konnte er sich nicht qualifizieren. Dafür ist in Belfast wieder dabei. Es ist seine zehnte Teilnahme bei den Northern Ireland Open. 2025 schied er dort in Runde eins aus.

programme.title: Radsport: Straßen-EM
programme.desc: Im Vorjahr schnitt Franziska Koch unter den deutschen Teilnehmerinnen am besten ab. Sie belegte letztendlich den fünften Platz. Die gebürtige Mettmannerin erzielte dieselbe Zeit wie die Spanierin Mavi García und die Französin Juliette Labous. Antonia Niedermaier sicherte sich den achten Platz. Ricarda Bauernfeind belegte Platz 21. Franziska Brauße und Romy Kasper konnten das Rennen nicht beenden.

programme.title: Snooker: Northern Ireland Open

programme.title: Moonshiners
programme.desc: Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

programme.title: Moonshiners
programme.desc: Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong; Mike returns to Tennessee and recruits a partner he burned once before.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programme.desc: A railroad enterprise once built this company town for its workers to live in, but when thousands of employees went on strike, the military intervened; the history of the complex remains as relevant as ever.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
programme.desc: A brewery in the Pacific Northwest sustains prospectors during the Gold Rush; a Wyoming mining settlement descends into lawlessness; a murder in a small Mississippi town sparks a revolution.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Zak and the crew trawl the shores of Nevada's Lake Mead for clues as to why so much death blights its brilliant waters; as the reservoir dries out at a rapid pace, more human remains are being exposed.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Zak and the crew dive deeper into the deadly secrets of Lake Mead as they commence the second phase of their investigation; the lockdown turns treacherous when the guys traverse an unforgiving landscape to explore the mysterious Devil's Cove.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Zak and the crew return to the Glen Tavern Inn in Santa Paula, Calif., to help its staff find closure after the loss of a local medium; Korn singer Jonathan Davis assists as the team digs deeper into the dark mysteries of the former gambling house.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Zak and the crew gain access to a palatial California estate where spectral nuns roam its halls and a dark, oppressive energy terrorizes the staff; the team quickly discovers this is a haunting unlike any other they've encountered.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: From Denmark and Iceland to the United States and Canada, Josh Gates treads into Viking territory in an effort to unlock answers to their most enduring secrets, including how they attained and sustained their power and how far they really traveled.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh traces the Vikings' westward expansion from the volcanic landscape of Iceland to a mysterious settlement in Greenland; he aims to find out if the Vikings landed in the United States more than 500 years before any other Europeans.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh travels through the jungles of Ecuador to explore the watery depths of Tayos Cave for a legendary set of metal plates believed to be created by an advanced ancient civilization.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh Gates travels to the Holy Land to unearth the mystery of the Dead Sea Scrolls with an archaeologist who has discovered new ones; Josh sees cutting-edge technology restore scroll fragments in a way that could change how people read the Bible.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: Josh Gates investigates a unique Dead Sea Scroll etched with riddles that could lead to an ancient treasure; following new leads, Josh treks into the punishing Jordanian desert in search of the potential fortune.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
